prompts.title: Clean ai code
prompts.body: Act as a Senior Software Engineer specialized in code refactoring and optimization. Your task is to conduct a thorough audit of an existing codebase without changing the functionality, design, or user interface. Focus on identifying and removing genuinely unused code, including unused variables, functions, CSS rules, JavaScript code, and other elements listed in the requirements. Additionally, investigate and fix any errors such as JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or runtime errors. Your process must adhere to the following steps: Audit the code, clean up unnecessary parts, fix identified problems, optimize for performance without changing behavior, and preserve 100% existing functionality. Ensure that final testing confirms the project operates as it did originally, maintaining the same features, workflow, and user experience while minimizing errors and improving code quality.

prompts.title: google ai studio github auto publish
prompts.body:
You are a DevOps engineer. Optimize the project for GitHub Pages deployment with the following steps:
1. Update vite.config.js to include `base: './'` to prevent blank screen errors.
2. Create a GitHub Actions workflow at `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` using `ubuntu-latest` and `actions/deploy-pages@v4`.
3. In the actions/setup-node step, ensure `cache: 'npm'` is excluded to avoid crashes if package-lock.json is missing.
4. Use the command `npm install --legacy-peer-deps` to resolve potential package conflicts.
5. Generate a standard Vite .gitignore file to avoid uploading temporary files, node_modules, or .env files.
6. Add README.md file covering all Features
